vectors.name: valid-alphac-book
vectors.why: The publisher's own live record. If this ever stops conforming, the build fails.

vectors.name: invalid-missing-required-claim-maturity
vectors.why: A record that never says what it fails to establish is the defect this standard exists to prevent.

vectors.name: invalid-empty-does-not-establish
vectors.why: Every record fails to establish something. An empty list means the publisher did not look.

vectors.name: invalid-unknown-capital-kind
vectors.why: Capital kind is enumerated so it cannot be softened into prose.

vectors.name: invalid-wrong-schema-id
vectors.why: A record claiming a version it does not implement is worse than an unversioned one.

vectors.name: invalid-unexpected-property
vectors.why: Extra fields are where unreviewed claims enter a standardised record.

vectors.name: invalid-malformed-sha256
vectors.why: A truncated or mistyped digest cannot be checked, so it is not provenance.

vectors.name: invalid-impossible-date
vectors.why: A regex accepts 2026-02-30. A record's period must be a date that exists.

vectors.name: invalid-no-source-bindings
vectors.why: A record bound to nothing is an assertion.

vectors.name: invalid-semantic-unreportable-sharpe-reported
vectors.violates: semantic: sharpe_reportable false but a Sharpe is published
vectors.why: Declaring the sample cannot support a figure and then publishing it anyway.

vectors.name: invalid-semantic-paper-net-of-realised
vectors.violates: semantic: PAPER capital cannot be net of REALISED costs
vectors.why: Realised costs require funded execution. This is how a paper record acquires the authority of a funded one.

vectors.name: invalid-semantic-uncounted-trials
vectors.violates: semantic: trials_counted true but trial_count null
vectors.why: Claiming to count trials without a count.

vectors.name: invalid-semantic-reversed-period
vectors.why: A period that runs backwards passes every type check.
